name: @vesk/native-cli
description: vesk-native CLI — init/build/run a .vsk app as a native Kotlin + Compose app

scripts.build:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/index.js --tsconfig=../../tsconfig.json --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
